name: Sikkim

topAttractions.name: Tsomgo Lake
topAttractions.description: A glacial lake at an altitude of 3,780 meters, surrounded by breathtaking Himalayan views and home to the endangered Himalayan black-necked crane.

topAttractions.name: Rumtek Monastery
topAttractions.description: A stunning example of Tibetan architecture, housing the sacred relics of the 16th Karmapa and offering panoramic views of the surrounding mountains.

topAttractions.name: Nathula Pass
topAttractions.description: A high-altitude mountain pass connecting Sikkim to Tibet, offering breathtaking views of the Himalayas and the opportunity to witness the unique culture of the Indo-Tibetan border.

bestTimeToVisit: The best time to visit Sikkim is from March to May and from September to November, when the weather is mild and the scenery is at its most breathtaking.
culturalFact: Sikkim is home to the Lepcha people, an indigenous tribe that has a unique culture and language, and is known for their expertise in traditional crafts such as woodcarving and weaving.

hiddenGem.name: Phodong Monastery
hiddenGem.description: A lesser-known monastery in the Phodong village, offering stunning views of the surrounding mountains and a glimpse into the traditional Buddhist culture of Sikkim.

relatedFestival: The Saga Dawa Festival, a Buddhist celebration held in May to commemorate the birth, enlightenment, and death of Lord Buddha.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps or wishlist items for the Himalayas, trekking, or Buddhist culture, Sikkim is a must-visit destination for you!
